name: Runner Tests Fixture - SingleInstance Session Lifetime
brief: #4781: SingleInstance codeunit state survives a test-codeunit boundary, and its Record globals read the rolled-back store.
description: AlRunner#4781. Two test codeunits run in id order; the second reads what the first left in a SingleInstance codeunit. The install trigger writes the same codeunit, and the first test must not see that. The runner-side mechanism is pinned in SingleInstanceSessionLifetimeTests.cs.
